name: Kilo Code
what: An open-source AI coding agent for VS Code, JetBrains IDEs and the terminal. With a Kilo account you can pick from 500+ models and switch mid-task; Kilo says you pay the model provider's rate with no markup. It also offers a cloud agent and automated PR reviews. MIT licensed.
who: VS Code and JetBrains users who want an open-source agent inside the editor and a choice of models.

setup.text: VS Code: install Kilo Code from the VS Code Marketplace (kilocode.Kilo-Code).
JetBrains: Settings → Plugins → search for "Kilo Code".

setup.code:
npm install -g @kilocode/cli
# or
curl -fsSL https://kilo.ai/cli/install | bash

setup.text: Run kilo in a project folder (or open the Kilo panel in your editor) and sign in to your Kilo account.

prompts: Explain what this file does and suggest a cleaner structure.
Add form validation to the signup page and write tests for it.
Review my staged changes for bugs before I commit.
